title: Finally! Here's the first look at my Ai Assisted Game! How can I improve??
author: Illustrious-Lake2603
selftext:
Here is the first look of my Retro Arcade shooter, "INFEST". I have been working on this for what feels like a millennia now.... since 2019, before Ai was a real thing. I was inspired by that really cool Arcade game "Centipede Chaos" (the really cool 3D voxel version), Galaga and FirstPersonShooters. So in 2019 I set-out to try to recreate my own version that captured the essence of those games and was supposed to be towards the VR headsets (during that time VR was becoming really big but then died in popularity). Fast forward to Claude Opus 5.5 and a million prompts later, and its to a point where I feel like it can be enjoyed by others. Obviously AI is great, but I have been working on this game for a long time, I'm praying that it doesn't come across as "Slop" in this era. Please let me know what your Super Brutal Honest Thoughts are. What Can I improve? What should be scrapped? How do you feel about this game so far? Here is a quick Trailer/Ad and Demo for the game. Let me know what you guys think. 

Demo: [https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade](https://panic-blazeit.itch.io/infest-the-arcade)
